name: Striga
source:
Because life must be wonderful.

A girl's despair, heartbreak, desires and ethics, distorted bonds.
In the midst of endless despair, a faint light can be seen.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ01017085.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
因为生活一定很精彩。

女孩的绝望、心碎、欲望和伦理、扭曲的纽带。
无尽的绝望之中，隐约可见一丝光芒。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ01017085.html]DLsite[/url]]
